summary: Artisan Partners Asset Management Inc. filed a Form 8-K reporting that its operating entity, Artisan Partners Holdings LP, entered into a new $150 million five-year senior revolving credit facility on September 23, 2026. Bank of America serves as administrative agent and letter of credit issuer, with Citibank as syndication agent and BofA Securities, Citibank and RBC as joint lead arrangers. Holdings may upsize commitments to $225 million. Pricing floats at Term SOFR plus 1.25%-2.00% or a base rate plus 0.25%-1.00%, with leverage-based commitment fees of 0.125%-0.275% and covenants requiring leverage not exceeding 3.00x and interest coverage of at least 4.00x.
